page0.text:
I go back to my bedroom after my bath.
Once I put on dry clothes, it finally hits me that I can sleep now.

page1.text:
"Haah..."
I sit down on the floor, shaking my sore shoulders, and sigh.
Today sure was a long day.
A lot of stuff happened, and there was a lot of trouble.
I had to part ways with someone and try to salvage what was left.

page2.text:
"Right, Sakura was Rider's Master..."
She let Shinji take control, but Sakura was Rider's Master all along.
Maybe Rider's nearby right now, watching over Sakura.

page3.text:
"...Yeah. I've run into her a few times already.
If she's going to protect Sakura, then we should have a conversation."

page4.text:
Her appearance makes her seem unapproachable, but I think she's actually a reasonable person.
And since I don't know when Zouken will cut Sakura off, I'll have to rely on Rider.

page5.text: According to Kotomine, Sakura's health will get worse the more she uses her Servant, so we should only count on Rider as a last resort.

page6.text:
"Okay. I'll have Sakura introduce us tomorrow.
Ahh...I bet she still holds a grudge after Saber beat her, though."
My shoulders slump in disappointment.
Anyway, we'll all be living together now that Sakura is home, so I should at least introduce myself—

page7.text:
"Who's there!?"
"Guh...!"
I jump to my feet, ready to respond to an attack, and squint at the sliding door.
...Someone's outside my room.
They're standing quietly in the corridor.

page8.text:
...
...Nobody answers.
The shadow is looking my way.

page9.text:
...
...Crap.
I don't have anything I can use as a weapon in here. If I'm fighting bare-handed, I'd better try to get the drop on them first—

page10.text:
"S-Senpai. Um, are you awake?"
"Huh? Oh, it's just you, Sakura."
I relax my tense posture.

page11.text:
"Feel free to use the bath. If you need fresh clothes, just borrow Fuji-nee's."
"...Okay. I already used the bath. I'm wearing Ms. Fujimura's clothes, too."

page12.text:
"???"
Then...what else is there to talk about?

page13.text:
"Um, Senpai...may I come in?"
"Sure. What's wrong?"
I slide open the door.
Sakura comes into the room, and...
...
Something's off about her, in her new clothes.

page14.text:
Someone gulps.
I realize that it was me, and my temperature shoots up.
"..."
I cover my flabbergasted mouth and look away.

page15.text:
"..."
It's pointless.
I want to stare at Sakura, even though I'm looking away.
I don't know why, but she's making me feel funny.

page16.text:
"..."
Sakura stands in the doorway.
I finally realize that she doesn't only look graceful, but that something's strange about her.

page17.text:
"...Sakura? What's wrong? Is your fever all right? Was it a cold after all?"
"...No. I do have a fever, but it's not because I have a cold.
My fever isn't...an illness."
She looks down awkwardly.

page18.text:
Sakura's been acting like this for the last few days.
...I thought I'd gotten used to seeing this side of Sakura I hadn't known before, to being conscious of her as a girl my age.
But...this doesn't even begin to compare.

page19.text:
"...Sakura?"
"It's no good, Senpai. I can't hold it back on my own."

page20.text:
"H-hold what back?"
"Inside me, the...I mean, even when we got home, the thought of how warm  your hand was..."
"..."

page21.text:
Sakura sways unsteadily.
I'm starting to think this is worse than just a fever.

page22.text:
"I...Senpai, why...Ah..."
My thoughts are sluggish.
It's clear that something is wrong with Sakura.
I know I should take her back to her room right away, but my feet won't move.

page23.text:
The silence is tantalizing.
Sakura drifts closer, like a breeze.
Her foot catches the edge of the tatami, and...

page24.text:
"Ah..."
Did I shout, or did she whisper?
Sakura weakly collapses.
I move my sluggish feet,
trying to help her up...

page25.text:
...But I don't make it in time, and she awkwardly falls into me.
There's definitely something wrong with her body.
She's warm, but her arms and legs are cold. It's like her body has a high fever, while her limbs are losing blood.
This isn't a normal sick fever at all.
Maybe someone poisoned her.

page26.text:
I look away.
Sakura buries her face in my chest.
...There's a long silence.
Sakura's crying quietly.
"...Sakura."

page27.text:
"...Senpai, why are you protecting me? The worms have eaten so much of me. It won't be good for you.
So why are you protecting me, even making an enemy out of Tohsaka—out of my sister?"

page28.text:
...My reason for protecting Sakura?
I don't even need to think about it.

page29.text:
"...That's not it. I wanted you here.
I need you, and I can't stand the thought of being away from you.
So...even if Tohsaka is your big sister, I won't back down."

page30.text:
"You mean, as a family member?
...Or do you see me as a girl?"

page31.text:
...
I don't see her as just a family member anymore.
I just failed to realize that over the last few days, I've always wanted Sakura to be with me.
...I'm long past pretending otherwise.

page32.text:
"...Yeah. I love you, Sakura."
I say it clearly.
...It's stupid. Once I was told that I would lose her, I finally dropped the pointless act.

page33.text:
"...Senpai."
Sakura trembles.
No, it might be me who's trembling.
Of course I'm nervous, lying down with Sakura in my arms and telling her how I feel.
I hold her a little tighter.

page34.text:
...It's quiet.
I thought I'd be more anxious, but as soon as I say it out loud, I feel much calmer.

page35.text:
"Sakura."
Sakura's shoulders move.
Her head trembles against my chest.
I told Sakura that I love her. So I'd like to hear her say that she loves me, too.
...Though, I don't mind if I don't get to hear it.
Tomorrow, we can spend a peaceful morning together, just like we always have.

page36.text:
"...Sen...pai."
Her tenderness makes me gulp.
Her voice is more meek than before.
It's a hazy, feverish voice.

page37.text:
"Ah...hey, Sakura...ah..."
Sakura's on top of me, and acting strange.
She isn't only feverish, she looks pained, like she's trying to endure something.

page38.text:
"Hey, Sakura...get ahold of yourself, are you feeling sick!?"
Her body gets hotter, while her limbs get colder.
I need to calm down.
I can't make her feel better, but Tohsaka—no, then maybe the church—no, it would be better to call Kotomine for help than to take her there.

page39.text:
"Stay still. Everything's going to be all right soon."
"Senpai...I...ah...hah, hah, hah..."
I need to put her to sleep, first.
Sakura squeezes me hard.
...She bites her lip in anguish.
I told her that I love her, but I can't even do anything for her.

page40.text:
"I want it...Senpai, I...don't have enough..."
She mumbles deliriously, dizzy with pain and shame.

page41.text:
"I can't...hold out. Can't take it anymore..."
Breaths get faster.
Both Sakura's ragged gasps, and my own as I hear it.
...I'm starting to lose my composure, being this close to her.
Anyway, I need to get her into a warm bed.

page42.text:
"Listen, Sakura. Wait—"
"...!!!"
Sakura tries to run...or rather, her body arches backward, and she grabs my hand.

page43.text:
"Ah... Sorry, Sakura."
"No, it's not like that, Senpai...I...no, I can't..."
I thought Sakura didn't want me to touch her, but I was wrong.
Her body is uncoordinated.
She grabs my hand, but when she tries to get closer, trembling, her upper body jerks away from me.

page44.text:
"Sakura? Hey, Sakura!"
"I can't, I shouldn't... You'll hate me... Ah...but it hurts so much...and your hands are so warm..."

page45.text:
The hand that Sakura grabbed inches closer to her.
...I can't pull away.
I can't so much as let go of her weakly resisting hand.

page46.text:
"Ah...Senpai...no, it's not enough..."
Her voice is bewitching.
She brings my hand closer to her, and then...

page47.text:
Her warm lips seek it out, and she bites it.
"Huh?"
I go limp in surprise.
Why is she doing this?

page48.text:
"...Ouch."
She chomps on it.
There's a slight pain in my fingertip.
Sakura's teeth break my skin, and my blood seeps out.

page49.text:
Blood flows.
Sakura's trembling gradually improves.
I can feel her terribly cold limbs starting to regain their warmth.

page50.text:
"Mm..."
She gulps.
I watch her throat swallow my oozing blood.

page51.text:
"...Ngh."
Her tongue laps the wound.
She makes quiet noises as she sucks my blood.

page52.text:
"Ngh...urgh..."
It's a pleasant feeling, like my finger is melting.
I feel the touch of her lips and the periodic caress of her tongue.
Moreover, for each drop of blood I lose, I feel sweet pleasure.

page53.text:
...I've felt this pain somewhere else before.
But right now, I can't remember when or where.
All I recall is how unsettlingly good it felt.
She's only sucking on my finger, and yet, the pleasure seeps from my wrist to my elbow.

page54.text:
"Mm...mmm..."
It's like the arteries leading from my heart to my finger are put into relief.
Blood suffused with magical energy dribbles into Sakura's mouth.

page55.text:
"Ah...aah..."
I try to look at the facts objectively.
Sakura is drinking my blood, enduring her shame. It's calming her body down.
Then...what's the problem with it?

page56.text:
"...Haah, ah..."
How much blood did I lose?
This feeling of lethargy must mean...
...that I've given at least as much as a blood donation.
Sakura licks my finger one last time, and then her lips quietly release my finger.

page57.text:
We look at each other, both saying nothing.
She looks in better shape now, but her uncertainty is still there.

page58.text:
"...Sakura?"
I finally say her name.
I push down the mysterious pleasure I felt from my finger, and the worry I felt about what was happening.

page59.text:
"Senpai... Ah, ah...!"
Suddenly, she lets go of my hand and scrambles away.

page60.text:
"Sakura...um, you don't have to say anything."
"...I'm sorry."
Her voice is terribly faint.
I look at Sakura's face, and see that she has her hands on her lap and eyes downcast, like she's cowering from me.
"...You must know, Senpai."

page61.text:
"I was raised as a mage in the Matou household.
...Because I'm from a different bloodline, Grandfather did things to my body to turn me into a Matou mage. That's how I have this grotesque body that always craves magical energy."
My black rage at Zouken Matou bubbles back up.
But more than that, Sakura's pitiful, emotional words move me.

page62.text:
"When I want power as a mage, the worms in my body start to twinge. Once that happens, there's nothing I can do to stop the hunger.
The worms eat up all of my magical energy, and it isn't enough, so they make me want more. That's why I..."
"...Drank my blood, right?"
"..."

page63.text:
She nods slightly.
...Sometimes, silence is the most damning agreement.

page64.text: "Magical energy dissolves easily into a mage's blood. That's why I wanted to drink your blood. It restores my magical energy and relieves my symptoms."

page65.text:
...Oh.
Her magical energy consumption must be intense, now that Rider has returned to her Master.
...She managed to live a "normal" life without any problems before now, so it hammers home how heavy the burden is.

page66.text:
"...It's awful, right? I-I wouldn't be surprised if you wanted to turn your back on me.
I've been aching ever since I came home with you. I can't think of anything else. You've helped me so much, but all I do is take from you..."
"..."

page67.text:
"...Senpai. I'm crazy, aren't I?"
Her husky, strained voice cuts me deep.

page68.text:
"Even when you were so worried and hugging me, I wanted your blood.
When you told me that you loved me as a girl, all I could think of was sucking your blood.
All I could hear was the worms moaning. They wanted comfort, soon, so I needed your blood, and I don't really love you, but as long as I get to drink your blood, maybe it's all right if I love you, so...!"

page69.text:
...
"...I'm sorry. How can a dirty person like me, who only feels good when she drinks your blood, have the right to be loved by you?"
Well, that's obvious.
Actually, I don't know why she's even asking.

page70.text:
"...You aren't dirty at all, Sakura. You're beautiful."
"Ah..."
I hug her again and whisper in her ear.
Is Sakura trembling and crying? Am I sad because I can't cry for her sake?

page71.text:
"...You idiot. I'm not going to hate you over a few drops of blood.
I said that I love you. I've been lying to myself and trying not to notice all this time, but you're really pretty.
...So don't be so hard on yourself. It isn't your fault that your body is this way."

page72.text:
I stroke her shoulders.
Sakura leans on my shoulder, sobbing quietly.

page73.text:
"Besides, I was happy when you drank my blood."
"...Huh? Senpai, that's..."
"It isn't weird. I'm happy that I can help you feel better, even if I can't cure you.
So don't worry about it. I'd be in a real dilemma if you hated me for the one thing I can do to help you."
I give her a light, reassuring clap on the shoulder.

page74.text:
"If you're okay with my blood, then feel free to drink it anytime.
I'm glad that it makes you feel better."
...I imply that I'm glad I fell in love with her.
It's a small, simple fact I can be proud of.

page75.text:
"...I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, Senpai..."
Sakura keeps apologizing.
Each time, I stroke her shoulder to let her know there's nothing to apologize for.
She trembles uncontrollably, like a young child.

page76.text:
"I love you, Senpai. That's why I don't like who I am.
But, if you'll still love me despite that... I have a favor to ask."
"...Sure."

page77.text:
"Will you help me the next time I'm in pain?
You won't hate me even if I drink your blood?"

page78.text:
I stroke her hair and tell her yes.
Sakura stops trembling, and then she smiles, with tears still in her eyes.
"...I'm glad I fell in love with you."

page79.text:
I feel a touch on my cheek, light yet full of affection.
When I touch the spot where her lips gently kissed me, I blush bright red, like I just remembered how.
We've touched each other countless times, but I suddenly feel embarrassed.

page80.text:
"...Well, uh."
"...Senpai..."
We separate, kneeling properly across from each other.
Everything that's happened is flooding my mind, and I can't move very well.
Sakura seems to feel the same way, and we both look around uncomfortably for a moment.

page81.text:
"...Thank you for all your help today.
I'm going back to my room, so...good night."
Sakura stands up hastily.
I don't have any reason to stop her, and I'm too shy to.

page83.text:
She slides the paper door shut, and leaves.
...Once I'm alone, I touch my cheek again.
It was an unavoidable ordeal for Sakura, but when I think back on it, I feel warm and fuzzy.

page84.text:
"...Time to sleep."
...I'd like to reminisce a little longer, but tomorrow will probably be a busy day, and I need to consider how to deal with Tohsaka. I need to speak to Rider, too.
...Besides, the Holy Grail War still isn't over. I need to defeat that mastermind Zouken and save—

page85.text:
...See, I really am sleepy.
My mind and body are tired, so I should get a good night's rest and get my head in the game tomorrow...

page86.text:
I'm dreaming.
I should be asleep by myself, but someone's snuggling up to me.
I'm physically and mentally exhausted, I shouldn't be able to get up, and Sakura's back in her room.
So if I'm sleeping with Sakura, it can only be in a dream.

page87.text:
...
Even in my dreams, Sakura is sucking my blood.
That's how titillating that experience was.

page88.text:
...I told her that I love her.
She kept calling my name, wanting me, and I want to reciprocate those feelings.
...
Sakura is sucking my blood.
Even in my dreams, she is sucking my blood.
I'm literally in a dreamlike state.

page89.text:
It wasn't enough. It would feel even better if she kept going until one of us broke.
Creation is a gentle delight, while decay is a fierce pleasure.
It's cathartic for both sides.

page90.text:
...
What am I thinking?
No matter what, as a human, I...

page91.text:
"Ah..."
My vision warps.
Sakura isn't here.
It was Sakura drinking my blood, but at some point, it became something I don't quite understand.

page92.text:
"Hah...guh..."
It's hot.
The ground under me is melting.
I sink in a bog that's hot enough to scorch me.
I drown in it, knowing that this is Sakura's body heat...

page93.text:
I'm having a terrible nightmare...
A sinister vision of a sea of hot coal tar.
